<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks between ~110–160 ppm correspond to aromatic carbons. The peaks at 151.10, 144.35, 140.45, 137.05, 131.30 (twice), 124.40, 122.30, 119.00, and 116.65 (twice) fall in this range, giving a total of 11 aromatic carbon signals.</thought>
<final_answer>11</final_answer>
